description: This file implements a fake timer and clock control system for testing purposes, including classes and functions to manipulate timers, performance, Date, and other global objects within a JavaScript environment.

classes.name: ClockController
classes.description: A class that manages simulated time, timers, and synchronization with real time for testing purposes.

methods.name: createClock
methods.description: Creates a clock instance and API for controlling timers and time-related functions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs fake timers and replaces global objects with mocked implementations.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects the fake timer system into the global environment and resumes the clock.
